name: limit_iges_with_a_step_extension
why: Asking for an IGES and giving a path that ends in .step makes it write a STEP with something else entirely inside, and the file exists, weighs and opens: it is the defect that gives no error, in its most trivial form. The extension is the only thing that tells SaveAs3 which format to write, and here we check that it matches the operation asked for.
